za/ui_invalid_image_attachments.previous: Gij dozsiengq daeb caeuq doxde mbouj habfap.

za/ui_drag_from_the_tail_towards_the_arr.previous: Rag daj baih duenh naq bae gyaeuj naq. Senj veh henz roxnaeuz coq saek rim ndaw.

za/ui_drag_from_the_tail_towards_the_arr.reason: Makes the start the arrow’s rear end; reuses the actual outline caption and keeps the fill alternative.

za/ui_some_previews_could_not_be_decoded.source: Some previews could not be decoded. You can remove those images or try saving the assembly.
za/ui_some_previews_could_not_be_decoded.previous: Miz geij aen dozsiengq iq doeg mbouj ndaej. Mwngz ndaej duz gij dozsiengq haenx, roxnaeuz swq rom gij dozsiengq doxcomz.
za/ui_some_previews_could_not_be_decoded.wording: Miz geij aen dozsiengq yawj gonq doeg mbouj ndaej. Yungh «Duz» daeuj duz gij dozsiengq haenx ok daj buek neix, roxnaeuz swq rom gij buek dozsiengq neix.
za/ui_some_previews_could_not_be_decoded.reason: Identifies previews, quotes the actual Remove control, and explicitly removes from the assembly rather than deleting original files.

za/ui_that_arrangement_overlaps_another_.source: That arrangement overlaps another image. Use a different edge or unplace the attached images first.
za/ui_that_arrangement_overlaps_another_.previous: Gij baiz neix dap gvaq lingh aen dozsiengq. Yungh lingh henz ndeu, roxnaeuz sien gaij ok gij dozsiengq daeb youq henz haenx, mbouj duz dozsiengq.
za/ui_that_arrangement_overlaps_another_.wording: Gij baiz neix dap gvaq lingh aen dozsiengq. Yungh lingh henz ndeu, roxnaeuz sien yungh «Gaij ok daj gij vih fongq» doiq gij dozsiengq daeb caeuq haenx.
za/ui_that_arrangement_overlaps_another_.reason: Removes the invented requirement to unplace only from the edge; quotes Unplace and preserves the other-edge choice.

za/ui_give_all_images_the_same_each_imag.source: Give all %1$s images the same %2$s. Each image keeps its own aspect ratio. Original files and crop settings stay unchanged.
za/ui_give_all_images_the_same_each_imag.previous: Hawj %1$s aen dozsiengq gij %2$s doxdoengz. Moix aen dozsiengq baeujcij beijlaeh gvangq / sang bonjfaenh. Vwnzgen yienzlaiz caeuq gij seizdin daet henz mbouj bienq.
za/ui_give_all_images_the_same_each_imag.wording: Hawj %1$s aen dozsiengq gij %2$s doxdoengz. Moix aen dozsiengq baeujcij beijlaeh gvangq caeuq sang bonjfaenh de. Vwnzgen yienzlaiz caeuq gij dinghdeih daet dozsiengq mbouj bienq.
za/ui_give_all_images_the_same_each_imag.reason: Keeps both arguments, each image’s own width-to-height ratio, and the unchanged original files and crop settings.

za/ui_normalize_width_input_percent.source: Common width as a percentage of %1$d px
za/ui_normalize_width_input_percent.previous: Gvangq doxdoengz (beijlaeh moix bak faenh %1$d px)

za/ui_normalize_height_input_percent.source: Common height as a percentage of %1$d px

za/ui_monospace.reason: Qualifies every individual character, not the width of an entire text box.

za/ui_sans_serif.reason: Uses the standard font category name in the localized font family labels rather than the ambiguous phrase about missing edges.

za/ui_serif.reason: Pairs with Saw sans-serif using the recognized category term without implying a visible border.

za/ui_sans_condensed.reason: Makes the width distinction explicit for characters, as opposed to stroke weight.

za/ui_sans_light.reason: Describes relatively light strokes, not narrow characters.

za/ui_sans_medium.reason: Qualifies medium as stroke weight, alongside Light and Thin.

za/ui_sans_thin.reason: Gives the thinner weight an explicit comparison within the same stroke vocabulary.

za/commons_import_raster_changes.reason: Preserves the machine-like background token and specifies compositing onto the white background rather than changing opacity.

za/gallery_credit_edit_hint.source: Before publishing, keep any named creator or copyright notices and add a description of changes you made. Remove sources that are absent from the published image. The text below is editable.
za/gallery_credit_edit_hint.previous: Gonq faenghbu, baeujcij mingz gij boux guh caeuq gij goenggau banjgienz miz haenx, caiq gangj mwngz gaij gijmaz. Duz gij laiyenz mbouj yungh ndaw dozsiengq faenghbu haenx. Gij saw laj neix gaij ndaej.
za/gallery_credit_edit_hint.wording: Gonq faenghbu, baeujcij mingz gij boux guh caeuq gij cihsih banjgienz miz haenx, caiq sij cingcuj mwngz gaij gijmaz. Ndaw gij cihsih laj neix, duz gij laiyenz mbouj miz ndaw dozsiengq mwngz yaek faenghbu haenx. Gij saw laj neix gaij ndaej.
za/gallery_credit_edit_hint.reason: Explicitly removes absent sources from the editable text, never deleting the files; keeps names, copyright, and the edit description.

za/ui_casual.reason: Labels the lettering style as informal rather than normal/default.

za/ui_third_party_notices.wording: Cihsih daj bouxwnq caeuq gizgvan wnq
za/ui_third_party_notices.reason: Identifies notices from other persons or entities, not a literal ordinal third person.

za/ui_gimp_translations31.previous: Mingz boux hoiz saw caeuq gij hawj yungh
za/ui_gimp_translations31.wording: Cihsih mingz boux hoiz saw caeuq gij diuzgienh hawj yungh
za/ui_gimp_translations31.reason: Keeps both translation attribution and licence terms, not just an informal grant of permission.

za/ui_hue_and_saturation_spectrum_lightn.source: Hue and saturation spectrum; lightness slider on the right
za/ui_hue_and_saturation_spectrum_lightn.previous: Fanhbouh loih saek caeuq gij saek na; rag diauz dingh gij saek rongh youq baih gvaz
za/ui_hue_and_saturation_spectrum_lightn.wording: Fanhbouh loih saek caeuq gij saek na; diauz rag dingh HSL L youq baih gvaz
za/ui_hue_and_saturation_spectrum_lightn.reason: Keeps spectrum and its two axes, and identifies the right control by the exact HSL lightness channel.

za/ui_hue_and_saturation_wheel_value_sli.source: Hue and saturation wheel; value slider on the right
za/ui_hue_and_saturation_wheel_value_sli.previous: Vongz loih saek caeuq gij saek na; rag diauz dingh gij saek rongh youq baih gvaz
za/ui_hue_and_saturation_wheel_value_sli.wording: Vongz loih saek caeuq gij saek na; diauz rag dingh HSV V youq baih gvaz
za/ui_hue_and_saturation_wheel_value_sli.reason: Keeps wheel and its two axes, and identifies HSV value rather than reusing HSL lightness wording.

za/commons_credit_copy_failed.previous: Lingh guh gij mingz boux guh dozsiengq mbouj ndaej.
za/commons_credit_copy_failed.wording: Lingh guh cihsih laiyenz dozsiengq daeuj nem mbouj ndaej.
za/commons_credit_copy_failed.reason: Same full credit object as the command, with clear failure.

za/commons_credit_copy_failed_reason.previous: Lingh guh gij mingz boux guh dozsiengq mbouj ndaej: %1$s
za/commons_credit_copy_failed_reason.wording: Lingh guh cihsih laiyenz dozsiengq daeuj nem mbouj ndaej: %1$s
za/commons_credit_copy_failed_reason.reason: Same full credit object as the preceding error and retains the reason placeholder.

za/commons_credit_copy_out_of_memory.source: Not enough memory to copy image credit.
za/commons_credit_copy_out_of_memory.previous: RAM mbouj gaeuq yungh daeuj lingh guh gij mingz boux guh dozsiengq.
za/commons_credit_copy_out_of_memory.wording: RAM mbouj gaeuq daeuj lingh guh cihsih laiyenz dozsiengq.
za/commons_credit_copy_out_of_memory.reason: Reports insufficient RAM to copy the overall credit rather than just the creator name.

za/commons_metadata_original_mismatch.source: Commons attribution does not match the selected original file
za/commons_metadata_original_mismatch.previous: Gij mingz boux guh Commons mbouj doiq cawq aen vwnzgen yienzlaiz deng senj.
za/commons_metadata_original_mismatch.wording: Gij cihsih laiyenz daj Commons mbouj doiq cawq aen vwnzgen yienzlaiz deng senj.
za/commons_metadata_original_mismatch.reason: Compares the Commons attribution record with the selected original file, not only the maker’s name.

za/commons_metadata_invalid_page.previous: Yieb mingz boux guh Commons mbouj hab yungh.
za/commons_metadata_invalid_page.wording: Yieb cihsih laiyenz Commons mbouj hab yungh.
za/commons_metadata_invalid_page.reason: Names the attribution page as a whole and uses operational invalidity rather than legal disapproval.

za/commons_metadata_field_too_large.source: Commons attribution field exceeds the text limit
za/commons_metadata_field_too_large.previous: Cih youq aen dieg sij mingz boux guh Commons lai gvaq soq dingh.
za/commons_metadata_field_too_large.wording: Cih youq aen giz sij cihsih laiyenz Commons lai gvaq soqmwd dingh.
za/commons_metadata_field_too_large.reason: Points to a specific attribution field’s text limit, not a particular creator name.

za/commons_metadata_cache_failed.previous: Rom gij mingz boux guh Commons mbouj ndaej.
za/commons_metadata_cache_failed.wording: Rom gij cihsih laiyenz daj Commons mbouj ndaej.
za/commons_metadata_cache_failed.reason: Keeps the whole Commons attribution as the object of the retention failure.
